# The caveman charges and the player jumps on it (263), stunning it (277); it lands at x 85. The yeti walks
# up and he jumps on it too (354), stunning it (367); it bounces over the caveman and lands at x 65. He walks
# left (421) to x 78, ducks (433) and crawls (437) to x 76, over the yeti's right side, and presses X
# (445). oPlayer1's step finds an enemy at his feet with collision_rectangle(x-8, y, x+8, y+8, oEnemy, 0, 0),
# whose x 68-84 touches the yeti's box and not the caveman's (from x 85), but picks up instance_nearest(x, y,
# oEnemy): the caveman's position (85, 96) is nearer the player's (76, 104) than the yeti's (65, 96), so he
# holds the caveman and the yeti stays where it lies. (Played without the yeti, nothing is picked up on 445;
# without the caveman, the yeti is.) He carries the caveman right (461) and stands there to the end, before
# it wakes.
